doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line -- "Bot Line would be better if it actually worked, but it's bugged and simply doesn't work" (per Amya). Hero pairing: Any. "Don't put" section is a literal X placeholder in the OP -- not fabricated here. Playstyle kit: cav has a charge on press 1 (Quick Charge) and a stomp on press 2 (Croupade); after press 1, a follow-up spell shows up for another sort of stomp; most of the time press 2 first because it gives a defence buff as starter, then press 1, then the follow-up spell. No separate "Tips & Tricks" or "Example Build" section given beyond the doctrine list. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset -- Sipahis is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
